scripts.version:patch: npm version patch && npm run update-version && git add version.json utils/version.ts && git commit -m 'chore: update version info' && git push
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor && npm run update-version && git add version.json utils/version.ts && git commit -m 'chore: update version info' && git push
scripts.version:major: npm version major && npm run update-version && git add version.json utils/version.ts && git commit -m 'chore: update version info' && git push
scripts.deploy: npm run update-version && npm run build
